layouts.name: CWindowData_GetClientBlurAttribute
layouts.notes: ForceIconicRepresentationChange and AlphaChange independently update the client-blur byte. Both use +737 in 28000.1516, corroborated by the constructor's default 0x40 bit; 28000.1 uses +673.

layouts.name: CWindowData_GetFrameThickness
layouts.notes: CTopLevelWindow::GetBorderMargins and _GetRightFrameThickness use the stored frame thickness when the computed border thickness is nonpositive.

layouts.name: CWindowData_GetHwnd
layouts.notes:
CWindowData::IsGhostWindow
xrefs to GetPropW — first parameter is the HWND, trace back to the CWindowData offset

layouts.name: CWindowData_GetNonClientAttribute
layouts.notes: GetCurrentStyle reads the active bit 0x02 and nonclient-rendering bit 0x08. ActivationChange independently updates bit 0x02, and the constructor initializes bit 0x08 from theme availability. These paths use +736 in 28000.1516; 28000.1 uses +672.

layouts.name: CWindowData_LivePreviewFlags
layouts.notes: CollectWindows/OnWindowShowHide set the glass-exclusion bit 0x80; UpdateResourcesForMonitorHelper tests it before including an ordinary window in the glass bounds. The producer and consumer use +674 in 28000.1 and +738 in 28000.1516, after insertion of the bitmap-source cache.

layouts.name: CWindowData_WindowType
layouts.notes: UpdateResourcesForMonitorHelper includes type 1 windows in glass bounds; FadeOutToGlass independently routes type 1 clones to the ordinary capture root.

layouts.name: CWindowData_GetWindowRect
layouts.notes: 28000.3231 GetActualWindowRect reads the physical window rectangle at CWindowData +48. CalculateWindowMetrics independently computes the source width and height from the same four coordinates.

layouts.name: CWindowData_GetProjectionBorder
layouts.notes: 28000.1 CWindowList::ShowProjectionBorder stores the CProjectionBorderVisual at +464; 28000.3231 uses the same field for CProjectionBorderVisualShim. The shim initializes its CContainerVisual base and owns either the projection-border or capture-border child according to the native feature switch. RenderRecursive on that container validates the selected child without duplicating native feature selection or ownership.
